measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential of the NPs suspended in deionized (DI) water at 40 ± 1.5 mV for nylon NPs and -66 ± 2.2 mV for PS NPs supports the observed colloidal stability of the nanoplastics. || The NPs were characterized with the Zetasizer Nano ZS (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, UK) equipped with a He-Ne laser (633 nm).
